feed.title: Point Vernon verified updates
feed.subtitle: Checked changes to Point Vernon access, facilities, rules, services, transport and local events.

entry.title: Private-property caravan stays clarified
entry.summary: The local-help guide now separates private-property caravan questions from illegal camping on public land, explains Council’s limited family-or-friends pathway and directs other arrangements to Council and tenancy guidance.

entry.title: Household battery disposal guidance added
entry.summary: The local-help guide now points to current Council battery-disposal information and distinguishes routine disposal from an immediate battery fire risk.

entry.title: Recurring family literacy listing added
entry.summary: The what’s-on guide now includes a source-led recurring literacy activity with a reminder to verify current dates, suitability and booking requirements.

entry.title: Barking-dog reporting pathway added
entry.summary: The local-help guide now explains the non-urgent Council pathway for recurring barking concerns while preserving emergency and animal-welfare routes.

entry.title: Community Hub service notice added
entry.summary: The local-help guide now records the temporary Hervey Bay Library and Council customer-service move, with current dates and a direct Council source.

entry.title: Noticeboard claims routed to verifiable sources
entry.summary: Food, local-life and moving guides were revised so time-sensitive community-noticeboard claims are supported, qualified or excluded.
